fieldPaths.description_en:
The AI request log field configuration groups for the API path, passed in as a Map. The Map keys are fixed to basic and custom, and the values are arrays of log field configurations for the corresponding groups. basic indicates basic log fields, and custom indicates custom log fields. For the current API path, fieldPaths represents the complete desired state of field configurations and does not support incremental appending or diff merging.

If pathFieldConfigs is not passed, is null, or is an empty array, the existing log field configurations are not updated. If a non-empty array is passed, the system performs a desired state replacement based on the complete set of Paths in the request, and historical Path configurations not included in the request are deleted.

For example, to add a custom field test to the /v1/chat/completions API path on top of existing configurations, the caller must use a "read-merge-write back in full" approach:
Read all current Path configurations.
Retain the complete basic array and custom array for the target API path /v1/chat/completions.
Append test to the current custom array.
Keep configurations for other API paths unchanged.
Submit the merged complete pathFieldConfigs
fieldPaths.description_zh:
API 路径对应的AI请求日志字段配置分组，以Map形式传入。Map的Key可选值固定为basic和custom，Value为对应分组的日志字段配置数组。其中，basic表示基础日志字段，custom表示自定义日志字段。对于当前API路径，fieldPaths表示完整的字段配置终态，不支持增量追加或diff合并。

pathFieldConfigs未传、传null或空数组时，不更新已有日志字段配置；传入非空数组时，将按照请求中的完整Path集合执行终态替换，未包含的历史Path配置会被删除。

例如如在现有配置上在/v1/chat/completions API路径需新增一个自定义字段test，调用方必须采用“读取—合并—全量写回”的方式：
读取当前全部Path配置。
保留目标API路径/v1/chat/completions当前完整的basic数组和custom数组。
在当前custom数组中追加test。
将其他API路径配置原样保留。
提交合并后的完整pathFieldConfigs

fields.help_en:
The AI request log field configuration groups for the API path, passed in as a Map. The Map keys are fixed to basic and custom, and the values are arrays of log field configurations for the corresponding groups. basic indicates basic log fields, and custom indicates custom log fields. For the current API path, fieldPaths represents the complete desired state of field configurations and does not support incremental appending or diff merging.

If pathFieldConfigs is not passed, is null, or is an empty array, the existing log field configurations are not updated. If a non-empty array is passed, the system performs a desired state replacement based on the complete set of Paths in the request, and historical Path configurations not included in the request are deleted.

For example, to add a custom field test to the /v1/chat/completions API path on top of existing configurations, the caller must use a "read-merge-write back in full" approach:
Read all current Path configurations.
Retain the complete basic array and custom array for the target API path /v1/chat/completions.
Append test to the current custom array.
Keep configurations for other API paths unchanged.
Submit the merged complete pathFieldConfigs
fields.help_zh:
API 路径对应的AI请求日志字段配置分组，以Map形式传入。Map的Key可选值固定为basic和custom，Value为对应分组的日志字段配置数组。其中，basic表示基础日志字段，custom表示自定义日志字段。对于当前API路径，fieldPaths表示完整的字段配置终态，不支持增量追加或diff合并。

pathFieldConfigs未传、传null或空数组时，不更新已有日志字段配置；传入非空数组时，将按照请求中的完整Path集合执行终态替换，未包含的历史Path配置会被删除。

例如如在现有配置上在/v1/chat/completions API路径需新增一个自定义字段test，调用方必须采用“读取—合并—全量写回”的方式：
读取当前全部Path配置。
保留目标API路径/v1/chat/completions当前完整的basic数组和custom数组。
在当前custom数组中追加test。
将其他API路径配置原样保留。
提交合并后的完整pathFieldConfigs
fields.name: field_paths

parameters.help_zh: Bse64编码的API定义，支持OAS2.0和OAS3.0规范，支持YAML格式和JSON格式。优先级高于specFileUrl参数。 若文件大小超过10MB请使用specFileUrl参数传递
parameters.name: spec_content_base64

parameters.help_en: The download URL of the API definition file. The URL must be accessible over the Internet or be an internal network OSS download URL in the same region. The URL must have download permissions. For OSS files that are not publicly readable, see References https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39607.html and provide a URL with download permissions. Only API definition files stored in OSS are supported
parameters.help_zh: API定义文件的下载地址，需要公网可以下载或使用相同region的OSS内网下载地址。文件地址要求拥有下载权限，对于OSS非公开读的文件链接，请参考文档https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39607.html，填写带有下载权限的地址。目前仅支持OSS上存储的API定义文件
parameters.name: spec_file_url

fields.help_en: The full path of the file
fields.name: object_key

parameters.help_en: The update strategy to use when the imported API name and version management match an existing API. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
当导入的API名称与版本管理与已存在API相同时，需要指定更新策略。
SpecOnly：完全以导入文件为准。
SpecFirst：以导入文件为优先，新增接口与更新已有接口，文件中未提及的接口保持不动。
ExistFirst：以存在的API为优先，只新增接口，不更新已有接口。
为空时默认ExistFirst策略
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: If this field is specified, the import updates the specified API instead of importing a new one or searching for an existing API by name and version management configuration. The target API must be of the REST type
parameters.help_zh: 若指定该字段，则本次导入将更新指定API而非导入或根据API名称与版本管理配置搜索已存在API。目标API必须是REST类型
parameters.name: target_http_api_id

fields.help_en: Indicates whether versioning control is enabled
fields.name: enable

fields.help_en: The key in the specified header parameter when the header-based versioning scheme is used
fields.help_zh: Header版本化方案时，指定的Header参数中的Key
fields.name: header_name

fields.help_en: The key in the specified query parameter when the query parameter-based versioning scheme is used
fields.help_zh: Query版本化方案时，指定的Query参数中的Key
fields.name: query_name

parameters.help_en: The API version configuration. If version configuration is enabled and the version number and API name match an existing API, this import is treated as an update. If version configuration is not enabled and the API name matches an existing API, this import is treated as an update
parameters.help_zh: API版本化配置，若开启版本化配置，则版本号API名称与已存在API相同时，本次导入将视为更新动作。若未开启版本化配置，则API名称与已存在API相同时，本次导入将视为更新动作
parameters.name: version_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to import gateway extension information
parameters.help_zh: 是否导入网关扩展信息
parameters.name: with_gateway_extension

errorMessages.description_en: The error messages. If the error messages are not empty, the API cannot be imported successfully
errorMessages.description_zh: 错误信息，若错误信息非空，则无法成功导入API

existHttpApiInfo.description_en: The information about the existing API. If this field is not empty, the import action updates the existing API
existHttpApiInfo.description_zh: 已存在的API信息。若该字段非空，则导入动作将更新该API

failureComponents.description_en: The list of data structures that failed the dry run
failureComponents.description_zh: 预检失败的数据结构列表

failureOperations.description_en: The list of operations that failed the dry run

failureRoutes.description_en: The list of routes that failed to be imported

successComponents.description_en: The list of data structures that passed the dry run
successComponents.description_zh: 预检成功的数据结构列表

action.description_en: The action to be performed after the dry run
action.description_zh:
预检后将执行的动作。
Create：创建。
Update: 更新

successOperations.description_en: The list of operations that passed the dry run

action.description_en: The action to be performed after the dry run
action.description_zh:
预检后将执行的动作。
Create：创建。
Update: 更新

successRoutes.description_en: The list of routes that were successfully imported

warningMessages.description_en: The warning messages. If the warning messages are not empty, some operations or data structures may fail to be imported
warningMessages.description_zh: 告警信息，告警信息非空，则部分接口/数据接口可能导入不成功

httpApiId.description_en: The unique ID of the HTTP API
